hints.external_endpoint: Document content is sent to an external endpoint: {name} ({host}).
hints.detector_not_ready: Detector “{name}” is enabled but not configured.

settings.label: Settings
settings.expert_mode_hint: Shows technical details (detector, confidence, timings) and allows combining the views freely.

gate.title: Sign-in required
gate.description: This installation is protected by your organisation's sign-in. Sign in to anonymize documents.
gate.note: You will be sent to your organisation's sign-in page. No document is processed before that.

errors.state: The sign-in expired or could not be matched. Please sign in again.
errors.provider: The sign-in service cannot be reached. Try again later or contact IT.
errors.token: The sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.identity: The sign-in service's response could not be verified. Please contact IT.
errors.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.unknown: The sign-in failed. Please try again.

input.dropzone_label: Select files or drag them here
input.dropzone_prompt: Drag files here or click to select
input.dropzone_hint: PDF, DOCX or TXT – several files are processed in parallel
input.dropzone_add_more: Drag more files here or click to add them
input.files_take_precedence: The selected files will be processed. Remove the files to anonymize pasted text instead.
input.disclaimer: Documents are processed locally by this installation. The result does not establish legal anonymization.
input.unsupported_file: File type not supported: {name}. Allowed are .txt, .pdf and .docx.

policy.intro: Here you decide how detected data types are replaced, and add your own rules. The default setting redacts everything detected.
policy.applies_next_run: Changes apply to the next run.

hints.CONSISTENT_TAG: The same person gets the same number throughout the document, e.g. {example}
hints.GENERALIZE: Only the year stays visible, e.g. 01.02.1980 → 1980

custom_rules.title: Custom rules
custom_rules.redact_hint: These terms are redacted always and everywhere – independently of the AI detection (whole words, case-insensitive). Example: internal ward names.
custom_rules.preserve_hint: Detected spans with exactly this wording stay visible. Caution: this reduces protection.
custom_rules.chips_placeholder: Type a term, add it with Enter or a comma
custom_rules.instruction_label: Additional instruction for the AI detection
custom_rules.instruction_placeholder: e.g.: Also report room numbers and study IDs (e.g. NCT numbers).
custom_rules.instruction_hint: Free text passed to the AI detection. It can only extend or sharpen detection – the standard detection and all deterministic checks always stay active.

ocr.title: Text recognition (OCR)
ocr.profile_hint: Several text-recognition models are configured. The choice applies to the next run and is kept per document.
ocr.force_hint: Always re-reads uploaded PDFs via text recognition instead of using an existing text layer. Useful for scans with a missing or broken text layer. Affects PDF uploads only (not text/DOCX) and makes processing slower.

output_language.title: Language of the result
output_language.label: Language of the placeholders
output_language.hint: Decides the placeholders in the anonymized document (e.g. {example}) and the language of the AI re-check's notices. It is fixed when anonymization starts: switching the interface language later does not change finished documents.

processing.queued: Queued – starts as soon as a processing slot is free …

batch.parallel: {count} documents are being processed in parallel

result.background_progress: Processing in the background: {done} of {total} completed

lifetime.expiring: The server deletes this result in {time}. Changes after that need a new run.
lifetime.expired_hint: The server has deleted the document. The next change recomputes the anonymization.
lifetime.at_maximum: Maximum retention reached — cannot be extended further.
lifetime.extend_hint: Result available: {time} left. Click to extend it.
lifetime.extended_at_maximum: Maximum retention reached — result available: {time} left.

status.review: Review needed – 1 notice | Review needed – {count} notices

export.keep_filenames_hint: Caution: filenames can contain personal data.
export.redaction_bars_hint: Scanned documents only: the reconstruction shows black bars – as a native PDF does.

original.unavailable: The original file is no longer available.

source.hint: Click a highlighted find for details – Ctrl/Cmd-click selects several, Shift-click a whole range. Or select any text to redact it manually.

pdf.areas_invite: Signature, stamp or logo still visible? The text check does not detect image content like that.
pdf.areas_marked: 1 additional area redacted. | {count} additional areas redacted.
pdf.reconstructed: Reconstructed document – layout approximated, the original pixels are discarded.
pdf.export_anyway_hint: The PDF will then show the same passages as the anonymized text.
pdf.forced_notice: This PDF was created despite an unresolved finding: 1 redacted text is still visible in it. | This PDF was created despite an unresolved finding: {count} redacted texts are still visible in it.

entities.cycle_title: Show the next span of type {type}

detail.search_in_result_title: Search this text in the result

selection.change_type: Change the type of all selected

areas.hint: The original pages are shown. Drag a rectangle over an area (e.g. a signature, logo or stamp) to redact it as well – clicking an area removes it again. Every change is applied immediately.
areas.truncated: Only the first {count} pages are shown.
areas.hint_redacted: The already redacted pages of the preview are shown. Drag a rectangle over an area (e.g. a signature, logo or stamp) to redact it as well – clicking an area removes it again. Every change is applied immediately.
areas.hint_reconstruction: The reconstructed, already redacted document is shown – this is exactly what the areas are applied to. Drag a rectangle over an area to redact it as well – clicking an area removes it again. The scanned original is in the “Original” panel.
areas.redacted_too_large: The redacted preview is too large to render here.
areas.remove_label: Remove the redacted area on page {page}

chips.placeholder: Type a term, add it with Enter

type_description.PERSON_NAME: Names of patients, relatives and clinicians

codes.docx_comments: The document contains comments, which are not extracted.
codes.docx_tracked_changes: The document contains tracked changes; inserted text may be incomplete.
codes.docx_tracked_deletions: The document contains tracked deletions, which are not extracted.
codes.docx_text_boxes: The document contains text boxes, which are not extracted.
codes.pdf_no_page_mapping: Page mapping is not available for docling-serve extraction.
codes.pdf_docling_fallback: docling-serve failed ({reason}); local extraction was used instead.
codes.ocr_recognition_errors: The text was produced by OCR; recognition errors are possible.
codes.llm_mention_not_located: The AI reported a span of type {entity_type} that could not be located in the source text. Please review the document manually.
codes.invalid_span_rejected: An invalid span from detector “{detector}” was rejected (offset mismatch).
codes.override_not_matched: An adjustment matched no detected span and was ignored.
codes.manual_selection_ignored: A manual selection no longer matches the source text and was ignored.
codes.pdf_preserve_not_honoured: One passage you kept also occurs elsewhere in redacted form. The redacted PDF blacks out every occurrence of a redacted text, so it stays covered there even though the text export shows it. Select all occurrences and keep them together if it should be visible in the PDF. | {count} passages you kept also occur elsewhere in redacted form. The redacted PDF blacks out every occurrence of a redacted text, so they stay covered there even though the text export shows them. Select all occurrences and keep them together if they should be visible in the PDF.
codes.residual_identifier: Redacted content of type {entity_type} appears to remain in the output.
codes.revalidation_hit: A rule still finds a possible span of type {entity_type} in the output.
codes.labelled_field: A labelled field appears to be followed by non-redacted content.
codes.llm_recheck_failed: The AI re-check could not be performed. Please review the result manually.
codes.llm_recheck_remaining: The AI re-check found a possible remaining span of type {entity_type} in the output.
codes.llm_recheck_unlocated: The AI re-check reported possible remaining personal data that could not be located.
codes.llm_recheck_skipped: The AI re-check was not repeated for this adjusted result.
codes.recheck_risk: The AI re-check rates the remaining risk of re-identification as {risk}.

errors.ocr_unavailable: This OCR engine is not available yet
errors.scanned_no_ocr: This PDF appears to be scanned. OCR is not enabled.
errors.llm_unreachable: The AI detection service is unreachable. The document was NOT anonymized.

errors.pdf_export_failed: PDF export failed. Please try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

export.pdf_export_residual_explained: PDF not created: {count} redacted text(s) also occur outside the redacted passages and would stay visible in the PDF — exactly as they do in the anonymized text.
export.pdf_export_residual_unexplained: Verification failed: a redaction was not applied in the PDF. The PDF was not created.
export.pdf_export_not_located: Verification failed: not all redacted content could be located in the PDF. The PDF was not created.
export.pdf_export_area_residual: Verification failed: text is still present under a blacked-out area. The PDF was not created.
